title: Single-space Parking Meter
description: Original S01 static single-space parking-meter prop with a faceted arch-top head, a genuinely recessed analog-display pocket with fixed gauge marks and pointer, a deep closed-back coin-slot recess, and a fixed winding handle. The continuous post sits inside a socket on a flat ground plate with four static bolt heads. Metre scale, source Z up, operator face -Y, root at the ground under the post. Five solid PBR materials, no textures. Independent editable closed components. Existing cycle-service post and bus-stop information pole contain no parking timer; this is an original transport-expansion prop. No operating timer, animation, coin handling, payment, billing, parking enforcement, security, stability, engineering or infrastructure certification.
